A long slender neck. The head is a long smooth living head of pale skin, plated with grown crystal facets fused into the skin, skin and sinew showing at the seams between the plates; the whole front of the head is one large flat blank polished crystal facet like a mirror, with soft coloured light moving deep behind it. Long tapering fingers. It wears a high-collared layered robe of crystal plates and silver mirror-thread fabric. This is Tamsa of the Clear Aperture, a Glasswright wing-mistress: a flock of tiny glass craft like starlings swirls round her raised hand, a wide collar shaped like an opening aperture ring.
